items.headline: Winless no more — the Chargers shock the Ravens on Monday night
items.body: The 0-8 Chargers finally broke through, upsetting Baltimore 23-20 on Monday Night Football for their first win of the season. Justin Herbert and rookie Omarion Hampton (105 rushing yards) built an early lead, and a late Zay Flowers fumble slammed the door on the Ravens.
items.say: Did you see the Chargers finally win one? They were 0-8, went into Baltimore and stole it on Monday night. You've gotta feel good for them. You following any football this year?

items.headline: Pochettino's goodbye — USMNT close out Haiti tonight before he leaves for Man United
items.body: The U.S. men finish their Nations League quarterfinal against Haiti tonight in Cincinnati, already sitting on a 6-0 first-leg cushion. It's also Mauricio Pochettino's farewell match — he's off to take the Manchester United job the moment the tie wraps.
items.say: Tonight's the USMNT coach's last game — Pochettino's leaving to take over Man United right after. They're up 6-0 on Haiti, so it's basically a send-off. You keeping an eye on the national team before the World Cup?

items.headline: Lights, Vegas, title fight — F1 hits the Strip this weekend with the crown up for grabs
items.body: Formula 1's neon night race is finally here (Nov 19-21), and it matters: with the season winding down, McLaren and Red Bull are locked in a tight championship battle as the cars scream past the casinos at 200+ mph.
items.say: F1 takes over the Las Vegas Strip this weekend — and the title's still up for grabs, McLaren versus Red Bull. The whole track runs right past the casinos, it's wild to watch. You into racing at all?

links.text: Las Vegas GP preview — F1 Nation (FORMULA 1)

items.headline: The big one's almost here — CS2's season-ending Major lands in Singapore
items.body: Counter-Strike's final Major of the year is set: the PGL Major Singapore — the first-ever CS2 Major in Southeast Asia — tips off November 25 with 32 teams, including red-hot FURIA, Vitality, Team Spirit and Falcons all chasing the trophy.
items.say: The last big Counter-Strike Major of the year is about to kick off in Singapore — the first one ever over there. Brazil's FURIA have been on fire heading in. You play any CS, or watch it?

items.headline: 'I Play Rocky' — the wild true story of how Stallone fought to be Rocky
items.body: Opening wide November 20 — 50 years after the original — 'I Play Rocky' tells how a broke Sylvester Stallone refused to sell his script unless he got to star in it. Anthony Ippolito does an uncanny young Sly, with Peter Farrelly directing.
items.say: There's a movie coming about how Stallone basically bet everything to play Rocky himself — out right on the 50th anniversary. The guy playing young Stallone looks spot-on. You a Rocky fan?

links.text: I Play Rocky — Official Trailer (Amazon MGM)

items.headline: John Travolta plays a mobster in the JFK thriller 'November 1963'
items.body: Roland Joffé's thriller imagines the mob's hand in the Kennedy assassination, with a near-unrecognizable John Travolta as real-life gangster Johnny Roselli. It's rolling into theaters this fall — and his transformation has people talking.
items.say: There's a new thriller with John Travolta as a mobster tied up in the JFK assassination — he looks totally different in it. Those 'what really happened' movies are always a trip. You into that kind of thing?

items.headline: Conway the Machine goes big — new album 'OTIS' drops Friday
items.body: The Buffalo rap heavyweight returns November 20 with 'OTIS,' a star-stacked record (Wu-Tang legends and more in the mix) led by the gritty single 'Diggwutumsayn!' Classic boom-bap menace, built for the weekend playlist.
items.say: Conway the Machine's got a new album out Friday — proper gritty New York rap, loaded with features. You still keep up with any hip-hop?

links.text: Conway the Machine — Diggwutumsayn! (Official Music Video)

items.headline: Noah Kahan announces his biggest tour yet — stadiums all over in 2027
items.body: The 'Stick Season' folk-pop star just rolled out 'The Last of the Bugs World Tour,' his largest headline run ever — a stadium trek across North America and Europe in 2027, capped by a milestone Wembley show. North American tickets just hit general sale.
items.say: Noah Kahan just announced his biggest tour ever for next year — the 'Stick Season' guy. His stuff is that catchy, sing-it-at-the-top-of-your-lungs folk-pop. You heard him?
